summary_en:
The study tests elacestrant, a pill that targets the estrogen receptor, together with trastuzumab and pertuzumab, in advanced triple-positive breast cancer. It includes patients with and without an ESR1 mutation. The study is Phase 1/Phase 2.
Elacestrant is taken by mouth once daily at 345 mg. Trastuzumab and pertuzumab are given by IV infusion every 3 weeks. All drugs continue until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or as the study doctor decides.
The main outcome measure is not stated. The study aims to assess safety and efficacy.
summary_es:
El estudio evalúa elacestrant, una pastilla que actúa sobre el receptor de estrógeno, junto con trastuzumab y pertuzumab, en cáncer de mama triple positivo avanzado. Incluye a pacientes con y sin mutación en ESR1. El estudio es de Fase 1/Fase 2.
Elacestrant se toma por vía oral una vez al día, a una dosis de 345 mg. Trastuzumab y pertuzumab se administran por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas. Todos los medicamentos continúan hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad inaceptable o según decida el médico del estudio.
El resultado principal del estudio no está indicado. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad y la eficacia.
who_for: Women aged 18 or older who can give informed consent.
Histologically confirmed triple-positive breast cancer (ER, PR and HER2 positive).
Disease progression after at least one line of prior recommended therapy.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Adequate blood counts and heart function (LVEF at least 50% or institutional lower limit of normal).
not_for: More than two lines of chemotherapy for metastatic disease, including antibody drug conjugates.
Other malignancy within the past 5 years, with listed exceptions.
